name: The Rose's Perspective
source:
In this game, you play an arrogant rich girl who has it all. Alexandra has a weapon; She can get rid of her enemies with just one command. With that, no one gets on her wrong side, until one day she passes by a flower shop and meets three guys who are not afraid of her. Alexandra cannot tolerate that and she must get rid of them with the help of her faithful butler.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141003225611/http://renai.us/game/rose.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你扮演一个拥有一切的傲慢富家女。亚历山德拉有武器；只要一声令下，她就能除掉敌人。就这样，没有人站在她这边，直到有一天她路过一家花店，遇到了三个不怕她的男人。亚历山德拉无法容忍这一点，她必须在忠实管家的帮助下摆脱它们。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141003225611/http://renai.us/game/rose.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
